notes: The regional page explicitly uses 'kWh entamé'; the energy component is therefore preserved as a started-kWh billing basis rather than silently normalized to continuous metering.
For daytime charging, 0.08 EUR/min starts with the second hour of charge and 0.16 EUR/min starts with the third hour; this is a charging-duration component, not a post-charge idle fee.
For the published 00:00-06:00 night window, the official grid shows only the energy price and does not publish an additional per-minute component.

Freshmile and other eMSP retail prices must remain separate from the union-published direct grid because the regional service warns that Freshmile is no longer aligned and third parties may add commission.
summaryLines: SIEEEN Nièvre current tariff grid is machine-verified from official regional sources.
22 kW daytime 06:00-24:00: 0.40 EUR per started kWh; from minute 60 add 0.08 EUR/min, from minute 120 add 0.16 EUR/min.
22 kW night 00:00-06:00: 0.25 EUR per started kWh, with no time component published in the current grid.
50 kW daytime 06:00-24:00: 0.50 EUR per started kWh with the same 0.08/0.16 EUR/min duration tiers.
50 kW night 00:00-06:00: 0.35 EUR per started kWh, with no time component published in the current grid.
Time surcharges are charging-duration fees, not post-charge occupancy fees; third-party roaming remains separate.
